_comment: Copy to <SQREADER_HOME>/plugins_config.json and pass it with
--plugins-config. Only keys you want to override need to appear under
'config' — everything else falls back to DEFAULT_CONFIG in the plugin.
Alerts are written to --stats-db and read back from GET /api/alerts,
which is live-gated (an alert names a player and calls them a cheater).
IMPORTANT: every 'sustained ticks' threshold is scaled to the production
tick rate of 0.5 Hz (--hz 0.5 => a 2 s tick). If you change --hz, re-scale
them or the detectors quietly change meaning. See sqreader/plugins/
